name: DOOM Eternal

scale.why: id Tech 7's cvars are in metres (eye height pm_normalViewHeight 1.657 m, i.e. about a 1.8 m player): values as given

gravity.note: the cvar default (800 in/s2 in metres)

speed.note: the run speed (375 in/s); backwards x0.9 (pm_backSpeedRatio)

jump.note: take-off speed for the 1.3716 m jump height: sqrt(2 x 20.307 x 1.3716)

dash_cooldown.note: the delay between dashes; each charge recharges in about 2 s (1 s upgraded) per a mod page

grapple.note: the Super Shotgun's Meat Hook pulls you to a demon (a weapon mod)

jumpHeight.note: Quark: 1.22 m; plus a double jump

extras: monkey bars, wall climbing on climbable walls
Meat Hook grapple on the Super Shotgun
no bunny hopping or air strafing to speak of
notes: Cvar defaults from a console-command guide (the game's cvars are in metres): run 9.525 m/s, gravity 20.31 m/s2, jump height 1.37 m, all within 5% of Quark's 9.5 / 22 / 1.22. Acceleration and friction cvars weren't listed. DOOM (2016) is not covered: only stopwatch timings that disagree with each other (230 vs 440 u/s) were found.
